what: Increase Stripe client timeout to 45 seconds and limit concurrent charge requests to 4 using a threading semaphore.
why: Stripe API calls time out under load and concurrent requests worsen the problem; the change prevents the service from failing.
revisit_condition: When Stripe stabilizes response times for batch operations and no longer times out under concurrent load.
anchor_snippet:
_charge_semaphore = threading.Semaphore(STRIPE_MAX_CONCURRENT)
with _charge_semaphore:
    charge = stripe.Charge.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency=data.get("currency", "usd"),
        source=data["source"],
        timeout=STRIPE_TIMEOUT,
    )
